scope: Zorgax Knowledge Profile Builder private-draft test

privacy.note: Only the minimized workflow outcome is recorded. The three private card bodies and evidence details remain in the participant-owned account.

evidenceBoundaries: Saving and reopening the three drafts is participant-reported and was not independently reproduced inside the participant account.
The private card bodies were not read, copied, imported or published by the automation.
A review request is not publication and does not verify participant-declared claims.
A human reviewer must check privacy, source relevance, ownership and the distinction between declarations and verified evidence before any public release.
